clips.speaker: Bloomberg
clips.title: SpaceX IPO后闪电收购Cursor 600亿美元全权益资产交易

subtitles.en: But let's start with the cursor deal if we may, so we knew that this could happen because they have the right to acquire cursor as stated in April.
subtitles.zh: 先说说Cursor交易吧，我们早知道可能发生，因为4月就规定他们有权收购Cursor。

subtitles.en: But they've moved very quickly since the IPO on Thursday Friday.
subtitles.zh: 但IPO后周四、周五他们就迅速行动了。

subtitles.en: What is it that you think SpaceX gets with cursor? What do you think they intend to do?
subtitles.zh: 你觉得SpaceX从Cursor得到什么？他们打算做什么？

subtitles.en: Yeah, you know, the company has been very clear that they want to have a role in the AI space and that they want to be one of the competitors within that space.
subtitles.zh: 公司明确表示想在AI领域占有一席之地，成为竞争者之一。

subtitles.en: And so with Groc, they have the opportunity here and now with the cursor team as you were just talking about earlier, they acquire a team here that they can ultimately come in and potentially give them a chance with the competitors in the space.
subtitles.zh: 通过Groc，他们有机会，现在有了Cursor团队，最终可能让他们与竞争对手一较高下。

subtitles.en: So I think it's brilliant. You have the successful IPO and the ability to come in and do the steal right on day three now.
subtitles.zh: 我觉得很聪明，IPO成功，第三天就能完成收购。

subtitles.en: Pretty big aqua higher. Pretty big aqua higher.
subtitles.zh: 相当大规模的收购人才。

subtitles.en: I mean, the mechanics of that I find really interesting because SpaceX's valuation actually is valuation today relative to Friday.
subtitles.zh: 我觉得机制很有趣，SpaceX的估值相比周五有优势，全权益资产交易。

subtitles.en: It's a bit of an advantage right in an all stock deal. How do you feel about it? You know, the mechanism, a $60 billion deal right now in how that impacts the stock as an existing investor?
subtitles.zh: 600亿美元的交易，对现有市场参与者权益资产有何影响？

subtitles.en: Yeah, look, we were already, we knew this was going to come, right?
en_highlights: knew this was going to come

subtitles.en: And so the fact that it's coming now it makes sense with the fact that this IPO was very successful.
subtitles.zh: 现在上市时机合理，这次IPO非常成功。

subtitles.en: I mean, they've done a fantastic job. The bankers, your Goldman Morgan Stanley did a great job bringing this to the public markets.
subtitles.zh: 他们做得非常出色，高盛和摩根士丹利成功将公司推向公开市场。
